## Architecture gallery

Author figures and editorial overviews are labeled individually. See the [figure credits](assets/architectures/CREDITS.md). Technical numbers refer to the documented configuration, not every family variant.

### ACE-Step 1.5 VAE

Encodes stereo music directly into continuous waveform latents for ACE-Step 1.5.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00744) · [Code](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5) · [Details](models/continuous.md#acestep15-vae)

**Audio:** 48 kHz stereo · **Frame rate:** 25 · **Nominal bitrate:** Not applicable: continuous latents

**Open license:** code [MIT](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5/blob/19671f406d603126926c1b7e2adc169acbcade22/README.md)

![ACE-Step 1.5 VAE — Figure 2 — parent ACE-Step 1.5 framework with VAE](assets/architectures/acestep15-vae.png)

*Figure 2 — parent ACE-Step 1.5 framework with VAE · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00744)*

<a id="acestep-dcae"></a>

### ACE-Step music DCAE

Compresses music spectrograms into continuous latents and reconstructs audio through a matching vocoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00045) · [Code](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/ACE-Step-v1-3.5B) · [Details](models/continuous.md#acestep-dcae)

**Audio:** 44.1 kHz (released vocoder config) · **Frame rate:** ~10.77 · **Nominal bitrate:** Not applicable: continuous latents

**Open license:** code [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/ACE-Step-v1-3.5B/blob/82cd0d7b6322bd28cd4e830fe675ddb6180ce36c/README.md)

![ACE-Step music DCAE — Figure 1 — parent ACE-Step system with DCAE and vocoder](assets/architectures/acestep-dcae.png)

*Figure 1 — parent ACE-Step system with DCAE and vocoder · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00045)*

### AudioDec

Reconstructs high-sample-rate speech with a streamable two-stage codec.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16608) · [Code](https://github.com/facebookresearch/AudioDec) · [Weights](https://github.com/facebookresearch/AudioDec/releases/tag/pretrain_models_v02) · [Details](models/speech.md#audiodec)

**Audio:** 48 kHz (also 24 kHz) · **Frame rate:** 160 (48 kHz / hop300) · **Nominal bitrate:** 12.8 kbps (selected 48 kHz model)

**Custom / restricted:** code [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://github.com/facebookresearch/AudioDec/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://github.com/facebookresearch/AudioDec/blob/main/LICENSE) — The linked custom or noncommercial terms apply to this release.

**Audio:** 16 kHz mono · **Frame rate:** 25 · **Nominal bitrate:** Not applicable: continuous latents

**Custom / restricted:** code [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://github.com/haoheliu/AudioLDM2/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://huggingface.co/cvssp/audioldm2/blob/c8e7e189d324425c05c4c2f81214041ef4107983/README.md) — The linked noncommercial or custom terms apply to this release.

**Custom / restricted:** code [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://github.com/happylittlecat2333/Auffusion/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://huggingface.co/auffusion/auffusion/blob/211aeb853fe565a306bb164d1227505e70558529/README.md) — The linked noncommercial or custom terms apply to this release.

Reconstructs speech from separate global speaker and time-varying semantic tokens.

**Custom / restricted:** code [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/SparkAudio/Spark-TTS/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0](https://huggingface.co/SparkAudio/Spark-TTS-0.5B/blob/642071559bfc6346c2359d19dcb6be3f9dd8a05d/README.md) — The linked custom or noncommercial terms apply to this release.

### DACVAE (Movie Gen)

Replaces DAC residual vector quantization with a continuous variational bottleneck for general-audio reconstruction.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13720) · [Code](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dacvae) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/facebook/dacvae-watermarked) · [Details](models/continuous.md#dacvae)

**Audio:** 48 kHz mono (Movie Gen paper) · **Frame rate:** 25 (Movie Gen paper) · **Nominal bitrate:** Not applicable: continuous latents

**License unclear:** code [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dacvae/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [Conflicting: Apache-2.0 / SAM License](https://huggingface.co/facebook/dacvae-watermarked/blob/8680102d141858a21bd533543966a2eb2e569f92/README.md) — The GitHub code is Apache-2.0. Checkpoint-card metadata says Apache-2.0, but its license paragraph says SAM License and references a LICENSE file absent from the inspected checkpoint tree; the weight terms need clarification.

![DACVAE (Movie Gen) — Editorial overview](assets/architectures/dacvae.svg)

*Editorial overview · [Source](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dacvae)*
